source: The house from the outside looked old but well cared for.
target: Domus exterius vetusta, sed diligenter conservata videbatur.

source: A few potted plants were hanging from the upstairs window; the walls were clean of the usual grime that became really familiar to Sam during his short journey with the little fey.
target: Paucae plantae in vasis e fenestra superiori pendent; muri ab sordibus solitis expurgati erant, quae Sam in brevi itinere cum parva nympha valde notissima erant.

source: The only thing that was really unusual about the house was the complete lack of decoration made of iron.
target: Unum quidem, quod vere insolitum de domo apparuit, fuit defectus absolutus ornamentorum ex ferro factorum.

source: Instead, every facet of the house was made from the famous ironwood.
target: Pro eo, omnis pars domus ex ligno ferreo celeberrimo facta erat.

source: Even the doorknob was made from the material.
target: Etiam manubrium ianuae ex eodem ligno ferreo factum erat.

source: This alone convinced Sam that he was in the right place.
target: Hoc solum Sam certum habuit se in loco recto esse.

source: Squaring his shoulders, taking another look around, he stepped forward and, with a hand that hesitated only a little, knocked on the door.
target: Humeros aequatos constituens, aliam circumspectans, processit et, manu parum morantis, ianuam pulsavit.

source: He waited for almost a minute when he finally could hear someone walking very slowly towards the door.
target: Paene minutum exspectavit, cum tandem audire potuit aliquem lente ad ianuam ambulantem.

source: And when the door opened, he almost expected an extremely old man, in a bathrobe and slippers.
target: Et cum ianua aperta esset, paene senem expectabat, indutum vestimento balneario et calceis mollibus.

source: Which was almost true.
target: Quod paene verum erat.

source: The man who opened the door was wearing something like a robe, though it was definitively not a bathrobe, and the shoes on his feet were more like very fluffy loafers than slippers.
target: Vir, qui ianua aperuit, vestem quidam similem gerebat, quamquam certe non erat vestis balnearia, et calcei in pedibus eius magis erant similes calceorum lanigerorum quam solearum.

source: He was also wearing a rather respectable beard and mustache combo, all of it in silver‑white with a few blacks, and for some reason, green strands of hair mixed in.
target: Etiam se gerens barbam et mustacium mixturam dignam, totum in albo argenteo cum paucis nigrioribus, et—quaedam causa—viridibus capillis interpositis.

source: The old man also had rather impressively bushy eyebrows that rose the moment he saw Sam standing at the door.
target: Senex etiam supercilia valde densissima habebat, quae statim surrexere, cum Sam ad ianuam stantem videbat.

source: Sam also felt a very delicate and gentle mana pulse go through him, no doubt looking for anything that could be a danger to the old man.
target: Sam etiam sensit subtilis et mitis vis magicae pulsus per se transire, sine dubio quaerens quidquid senem in discrimen adducere posset.

source: They spent the next dozen or so seconds staring at each other when the old man just sighed and spoke up.
target: Inter se aspicientes, per circiter duodecim secunda, senex tandem suspiravit et loqui coepit.

source: "Well, what do you want?” his voice was old, but the expected weakness that was ever present in every old person Sam ever talked with was not present.
target: "Quid vis?" vox eius antiqua erat, sed infirmitas exspectata, quae in omnibus senibus cum quibus Sam locutus erat, absens erat.

source: Instead, his voice radiated a certain power that caused a small shiver to run down Sam’s spine.
target: Proinde, vox eius emittens erat certa potentia, quae parvum tremorem in spina Sam excitavit.

source: "Good day, Sir!” replied Sam, followed by a respectful bow of the head.
target: "Bonum diem, domine!" respondit Sam, deinde caput reverenter inclinans.

source: "I’m here to ask you a few questions.”
target: "Venio ut te quaedam interrogem."

source: "About what?”
target: "Quid de re?"

source: "The ironwoods, sir.”
target: "De ligno ferreo, domine."

source: While Sam wanted to be circumspect, he knew that the only in with the old man was by being truthful.
target: Dum Sam circumspectus esse vellet, sciebat solum per sinceritatem viro senex placere.

source: And who knows, maybe he was powerful enough to see through his lies.
target: Et quis scit; fortasse tam potens esset ut mendacia eius perspiceret.

source: The old man’s eyes narrowed at him the moment he spoke, and Sam could feel the gentle magic settle around him, now with a slight edge to it.
target: Oculi senis in eum contracti sunt, simul cum locutus esset, et Sam sensit vim magicam lenem circa se consedisse, nunc leviter acuta.

source: "I know nuttin’!” The answer came out more of a growl than actual speech, while the magic around Sam turned from containing a slight edge to being a literal storm of magic, poised to destroy him.
target: "Nihil scio!" Responsum plus rugitus quam sermo fuit, dum vis magica circum Sam a leviter acuta ad veram tempestatem magicam convertit, paratam eum perdere.

source: So he talked. Fast.
target: Itaque, celeriter locutus est.

source: "The Silvercrest family sent me! To help them recover the Chalice of…”
target: "Familia Silvercrest me misit! Ut eos adiuvarem Calix Coercitionis recuperare…"

source: "...Restraint,” finished the old man for him, a scowl on his face.
target: "...Coercitionem," finivit senex pro eo, vultu contrecto.

source: And to Sam’s relief, the mana surrounding him quieted down a little.
target: Et, ad solacium Sam, vis magica circa eum leviter quietata est.

source: But then the older man fell silent, looking directly at him, and Sam would have sworn that he looked through him, searching for something.
target: Sed deinde senex tacuit, directe in eum aspiciens, et Sam iuravit se eum pervigilare, aliquid quaerens.

source: Finally, after several minutes of uncomfortable silence, the man sighed, the mana vanished, and he began to turn around while spitting out a few words.
target: Denique, post paucis minutis silentii molestissimi, vir suspiravit, vis magica evanuit, et convertere coepit dum pauca verba exsputabat.

source: "You better come in then…”
target: "Melius ut intres…"

source: Sam let out a relieved sigh, shook himself, and stepped through the doorstop while desperately ignoring the haunting laughter originating from somewhere in the street.
target: Sam leviter suspiravit, se concussit, et per limen ianuae processit, desperanter ignorans risum lugubrium, ex platea provenientem.

source: The interior of the house was reminiscent of the exterior.
target: Interior domus exteriori similis erat.

source: Simple, but well kept.
target: Simplicis, sed bene conservata.

source: Lots of potted plants, several comfortable chairs, a merrily roaring fireplace, and shelves full of books that were no doubt full of mysterious secrets that most mage guilds would sacrifice the firstborns of their guild masters to possess.
target: Multae plantae in vasis, plurima sedilia commoda, et focus hilariter crepitans, et scrinia libris referta, quae indubitanter arcana mysteria replebant, pro quibus pleraque collegia magorum primogenitos magistrorum suorum immolabant.

source: The old ranger, Marak, led him from the door through a corridor to a living room and bade Sam to sit in one of the armchairs in front of the fireplace, while he gingerly sat down in the other one.
target: Senex custos silvarum, Marak, eum a ianua per corridorium ad triclinum duxit et iussit Sam ut in una sella ante focum consederet, dum ipse caute in alia sede consedit.

source: He watched as the old man let out a content sigh as he eased himself into the chair with closed eyes, then turned his attention to the rest of the room, waiting for the other man to call on him.
target: Observavit senem suspirare contentum, dum oculos clausos habens in sellam se commode demittebat, deinde aliam partem cubiculi attendens, exspectans alterum eum ad loquendum vocare.

source: He was very aware of the fact that as far as the other man was concerned; he was practically nothing on the power scale.
target: Valde animadvertit se, quatenus altero, fere nihil esse in scala potentiae.

source: Even his skill Discernment was only telling him that there was no chance of a snowball in hellfire that he could defeat the old ranger.
target: Etiam ars ipsius, Discernmentum, indicabat nullam esse occasionem, quo globo nivis in igne infero senem custodem superare posset.

source: At least the skill leveled up.
target: Saltem ars in gradum altiorem elevata est.

source: After another uncomfortable silence, the older man finally opened his eyes, and Sam felt another pulse of mana sweep through him and then through the room, finally stopping at the walls.
target: Post alium silentium molestum, senex senior tandem oculos aperuit, et Sam sensit aliam impulsionem vis magicae per se et per cubiculi spatiem fluere, denique ad muros consistere.

source: ‘Probably for security…’ he thought as he looked apprehensively at the ranger sitting across from him, while the fire merrily burned, letting out a few sparks and odd cracks.
target: ‘Fortasse ad securitatem…’ cogitavit, dum sollicitus aspiciebat custodem silvarum sedentem trans eum, dum focus iucunde ardebat, paucas scintillas et insolitas crepitus sonos emittens.

source: "The artifact you seek… The Silvercrest family seeks, exists,” began the ranger, looking directly into Sam’s eyes.
target: "Artifactum quod quaeris… quod Familia Silvercrest quaerit, existit," inceptavit custos, directe in oculos Sam spectans.

source: "However, there is a problem…”
target: "Attamen, quaestio est…"

source: "Of course, there is a problem,” exclaimed Sam, rolling his eyes.
target: "Certe, problema est," exclamavit Sam, oculos volvens.

source: "What is it? Was it stolen? A powerful monster decided to nest at the place it was hidden? Let me guess, there was even a prophecy about it?”
target: "Quid est? Furtumne factum est? An monstrum potentissimum, in loco ubi celatum erat, nidum condidit? Conjecturo: etiam vaticinium de eo fuisse?"

source: The old man stared at him for a few seconds, then chuckled a little.
target: Senex eum per pauca secunda aspiciens, deinde parum risit.

source: "No prophecy, young man, so you don’t have to worry about that.”
target: "Nullum vaticinium, iuvenis, ergo de eo non curandum est."

source: "Then what do I have to worry about?”
target: "Quid ergo mihi curandum est?"

source: "There is indeed a powerful monster.”
target: "Revera, monstrum potentissimum est."

source: "Well, great… What is it? And why is it still alive if the Chalice is where I think it is?”
target: "Bene, optime… Quid est? Et cur adhuc vivat, si Calix Coercitionis in loco, quem puto esse, sit?"

source: Marak’s eyes narrowed at him at that, but he still answered.
target: Marak oculos in eum adstrictos habuit, sed tamen respondit.

source: "It is alive because we don’t know what the monster is. It is a powerful illusion user, and none of us are that good with them.”
target: "Illud vivit, quia nesciamus quid monstrum sit. Illud est usor potentissimus illusionum, et nemo nostrum in his tam peritus est."

source: "What do you mean us?” asked Sam, now officially curious.
target: "Quid significas 'nos'?" inquit Sam, nunc vere curiosus.

source: He wasn’t really worried about the illusion monster.
target: De illo monstro illusionum non vere sollicitus erat.

source: At this level, it could only be a few things, and the area allowed him to further narrow it down.
target: In hoc gradu, id solum paucis rebus esse poterat, et regio eum ulterius circumscribere sinit.

source: "The guardians of the woods,” came the simple reply.
target: "Custodes silvarum," respondit simplex.

source: "We walk the woods, protect them and make sure the cycle of life continues…”
target: "Ambulamus per silvas, eas protegemus, et curamus ut circulus vitae permaneret…"

source: "Why not call in some outside expert?”
target: "Cur non advocamus aliquem peritum exterius?"

source: The old ranger shook his head.
target: Senex custos caput concussit.

source: "Too big a chance that our secret would get out. Plus, the monster was content to stay there… Nobody needed that area.”
target: "Nam nimis magna erat occasio ut nostrum secretum efferretur; insuper monstrum ibi manere contentum erat… Nemo illam regionem requirebat."

source: "Until now…”
target: "Usque nunc…"

source: "Until now, yes.”
target: "Usque nunc, quidem."

source: There was another silence as the two of them stared at each other until Sam sighed.
target: Aliud silentium inter eos constantem fuit, dum se inter se intuabant, donec Sam suspiravit.

source: "Let me guess… You want me to go there and try to get rid of the monster?”
target: "Coniecturam fac… Visne ut ibi irem et monstrum depellam?"

source: "Hmm, I suppose… If you want to,” came the answer, with a slight smirk on the man’s face.
target: "Hmm, opinor… Si vis," respondit, leviter subridens vultu.

source: "Well, I don’t particularly want to, I need to…” replied Sam, thinking back to the Blood Contract he had signed with a slight ache in his heart.
target: "Bene, non mihi maxime placet, sed necesse est..." respondit Sam, reminiscens Pactum Sanguinum quod subscripserat, cum leve dolore in corde.

source: And based on how the smirk widened on the old man’s face, Sam was pretty sure the man also knew he was under the contract.
target: Et ex modo quo vultus senis subridet, Sam satis certus erat eum etiam scire se sub pacto esse.

source: Curse his bleeding heart…
target: Maledicat cor sanguinolentum!

source: "Indeed, sometimes the need for adventure is just too great! Were I a few decades younger, why, I would be joining you right out of the door, such is the call of the adventure!” spoke the man, his entire tone filled with laughter.
target: "Revera, aliquando necessitas adventurae nimis magna est! Si paucis annis minus essem, ex ianua te adiunxerim, tanta est vocatio adventurae!" inquit vir, totum risu impletum.

source: "Very funny,” retorted Sam, glaring.
target: "Valde iocosum," refertavit Sam, aspiciens acerrime.

source: "Now tell me what you want me to do, and I’ll leave you staring uselessly at the fire.”
target: "Nunc dic mihi quid vis ut faciam, et te relinquam ad ignem stultum spectantem."

source: The old ranger snorted, but the grin didn’t leave his face.
target: Senex custos sibilavit, sed risus eius in facie manebat.

source: "Very well, my young friend. I suppose an adventurous spirit like yours should be rewarded!” he exclaimed then jumped out of his chair, completely ignoring his age and stepped up to one of the shelves that was filled to the brim with books, scrolls and stray sheets of papers and parchments.
target: "Optime, iuvenis amice. Opinor spiritum adventurosum tuum remunerandum esse!" exclamavit, deinde e sella subsiluit, aetate sua prorsus neglexa, et accessit ad scrinium unum, quod libris, volumina, schedis et membranis dispersis plenum erat.

source: Sam watched as the man searched for a few seconds before exclaiming.
target: Sam aspiciebat dum vir per pauca secunda quaerebat, deinde exclamavit.

source: "Aha!”
target: "Ahā!"

source: Then he retrieved a scroll wedged between a book titled ‘Bounciest places in all the Kingdom” and another titled “You and your tools, how to protect them but still keep them useful!”
target: Deinde evolvit scrollum inter librum titulado "Loca maxime saltabilia in toto Regno" et alium titulado "Tu et Instrumenta Tua: Quomodo Ea Protegeris Sed Utilia Servabis!"

source: Sam just shook his head.
target: Sam solum caput concussit.

source: ‘Pervy old man…’
target: "Lascivus senex…"

source: The man thankfully couldn’t read his thoughts and returned with the scroll and, with a quick and decisive motion, unrolled it on the small table between the two chairs.
target: Vir, gratias, cogitationes eius legere non potuit, et rediit cum scrollo, et celeriter ac certissime illud super parvam mensam inter duas sellas evolvit.

source: Sam leaned forward and quickly took in the map that was revealed to him.
target: Sam se inclinavit et celeriter mappam, quae ei ostensa erat, intuens accepit.

source: "The city is here, and you need to go there,” pointed out the old man, his gnarled fingers moving through the map as Sam scrambled to memorize the route.
target: "Haec urbs est, et ad eam ire debes," inquit senex, digitis rugosis per mappam movens, dum Sam iter meminisse conabatur.

source: "And what am I doing when I get there?” He asked, not daring to look away from the map.
target: "Quid agam, cum ad eam pervenerim?" inquit, non ausus mappam relinquere.

source: The grin on the old ranger’s face was even bigger.
target: Risus in facie senis custodi maiorem erat.

source: "What else, but what do you need to do? Deal with the monster, retrieve the treasure, and save the damsel. You know, my young but foolish friend, standard adventurer stuff…”
target: "Quid aliud, nisi quid facias? Pugna cum monstro, thesaurum recupera, et puellam salva; scis, iuvenis sed insipienter amice, haec sunt munera vulgares adventurarum…"

source: "Any other helpful information?”
target: "Alia notitia utilis?"

source: "Yes.”
target: "Ita."

source: Sam just stayed silent.
target: Sam silentium retinuit.

source: "Make sure to prepare to deal with illusions.”
target: "Praepara te ad illusiones superandas."

source: He threw an incredulous look at the other man, who simply raised his hands defensively.
target: Incredulus eum aspexit, et ille simpliciter manus suas extulit ad defensionem faciendam.

source: "Just wanted to make sure. You never know with adventurers… Most of them are in the belief if they swing their swords hard enough, they would get through everything!”
target: "Modo certiorem facere volui. Nescis enim de adventurīs… Plurimi putant, si gladios satis fortiter ferant, omnia superare posse!"

source: Sam just sighed again.
target: Sam iterum suspiravit.

source: "Alright, just tell me what you know about the monster…”
target: "Bene, dic mihi quid de monstro nosti…"

source: A few hours later he found himself in the eating hall of the Cloudy Day inn, angrily eating his dinner while staring at his screens.
target: Paucis horis post, se in aula cenandi deversorii "Cloudy Day" invenit, cenam irate edens, dum in scrinia sua spectabat.

source: [You received a new quest!]
target: [Novum inceptum accepisti!]

source: [To peek or not to peek?]
target: [Inspicere an non inspicere?]

source: [Master Ranger Marak has told you of a mysterious illusion using monster plaguing the area where an artifact you seek resides. Your task is to scout out the monster and hopefully deal with it, in any way you decide.]
target: [Magister custos silvarum Marak tibi narravit de monstro usore illusionum mysterioso, qui in regione, ubi residet artifactum quod quaeris, infestat. Officium tuum est monstrum explorare atque, fortasse, quacumque ratione, cum eo agere.]

source: [Time Limit: As long as Lady Silvercrest lives.]
target: [Terminus temporis: quoad domina Silvercrest vivit.]

source: [Failure: Lady Silvercrest dies. The Chalice of Restraint gets destroyed.]
target: [Defectus: Domina Silvercrest moritur. Calix Coercitionis delebitur.]

source: [Penalty: Death. The Fey will be angry with you.]
target: [Poena: Mors. Fae te irascent.]

source: [Reward: Chance to retrieve the Chalice of Restraint. A reward from Master Ranger Marak. Additional rewards are possible.]
target: [Praemium: Occasio Calix Coercitionis recuperandi. Praemium a Magistro Custode Silvarum Marak. Praemia addita possibilia sunt.]

source: Because of course, the sub‑quest could be complicated!
target: Nam scilicet, sub quaestio esse poterat intricata!

source: At least the rewards were good.
target: Saltem praemia bona erant.

source: As Sam thought about it, he realized that based on the tropes that were prevailing in his last life; he wasn’t supposed to kill the monster, but rather befriend it and turn it into an additional defender of the city of Ironwood. Probably…
target: Cum Sam cogitaret, intellexit ex tropis, quae in vita sua priori vigebant, non oportere monstrum interficere, sed potius illud amicitiam suscipere atque additum in defensione civitatis Ligni Ferrei convertere. Probabiliter…

source: Sadly, the information he received from the old man wasn’t enough to narrow it down enough to make sure his preparations were hundred percent successful.
target: Tristiter, notitiae a viro senior receptae non suffecerunt ad eam totam determinandam, ut praeparationes eius centum per centum prospere evenirent.

source: Finishing his meal, he stood up and began to murmur.
target: Cenam finita, surrexit et murmurare coepit.

source: "Welp, time to do some research!”
target: "Heu, tempus est ad inquisitionem exercendam!"

source: It was mostly for the game system to know what he was thinking, as it would be rather hard to explain how he knew how to deal with dozens of different illusion‑using monsters.
target: Id maxime erat, ut systema ludi sciret quid cogitaret, nam difficillimum esset explicare quomodo cum multitudine monstrorum, qui illusionibus uterentur, agere posset.

source: Then bidding goodbye to the waitress, thanking her for the food, he returned to his room, played with Lucky a little, then laid down on the bed, and simply logged out.
target: Deinde, ministram valedicitans et ei pro cibis gratias agens, ad cubiculum rediit, pauulum cum Lucky luserit, deinde in lecto se collocavit, et sessionem ludens simpliciter finivit.

source: Sam went through his routine, then after angrily eating something to sate his hunger, he sat in his office for a few minutes and stared at his whiteboard, trying to divine some kind of information from it.
target: Sam consuetudinem suam egit, et postquam irate aliquid edens famem saturavit, in officio suo per aliquot minuta sedebat et tabulam album intuens quaedam notitia divinabat.

source: Sadly, the other Sam didn’t have anything on his current quest.
target: Tristiter, alter Sam nihil de sua quaestione praesentis habebat.

source: By the time he joined the game, the city of Ironwood was already rebuilding from the effects of the Monster Break.
target: Cum in ludum se redierit, urbs Ligni Ferrei iam ex effectibus Monstri Rupturae reconstructa erat.

source: Sighing, he shook his head, stood up from his thinking stool and went to his computer.
target: Suspirans, caput concussit, ex sellis cogitandi surrexit et ad computatrum suum ivit.

source: Might as well cheer himself up by checking on how the troll hunt was going.
target: Fortasse se alacer facere posset, intuentem quomodo venatio trollorum procederet.

source: Unfortunately, it wasn’t meant to be.
target: Infeliciter, non evenit.

source: The moment he pulled up the first news site that talked about Magic Unbound, he was instantly bombarded with headlines.
target: Cum primum situm nuntiorum, qui de Magia Unbound disserebat, aperuisset, statim tituli eum oppresserunt.

source: Troll hunt gets trollish
target: "Venatio trollorum trollesce fit."

source: Magic Unbound is the new game to troll people
target: "Magia Unbound est novum ludum ad homines trollendos."

source: Troll-ololo! The hunt is on!
target: "Troll-ololo! Venatio incipit!"

source: And so on, as far as his eyes could see.
target: "Et cetera, quantum oculi eius videre poterant."

source: Apparently, the game exploded.
target: Apparenter, ludus explosus est.

source: Sitting up straighter, he began to browse the net, checking everything out.
target: Sedit rectius, et per rete omnia explorare coepit.

source: Minutes later, he sat back and began to massage his temples.
target: Minutis post, se iterum consedit et tempora sua leniter tractare coepit.

source: Apparently, by revealing the secret of the Life of Blood skill book, he set so many guilds against each other that the fights and skirmishes between them caught the attention of a few big‑name streamers (and of course uncountable no‑name streamers) and from there it was like a runaway train.
target: Apparenter, secreto libri artis "Vitae Sanguinis" revelando, tot collegia inter se adversa instituit, ut pugnae et brevissima proelia inter eas notitiam paucorum emissariorum famosorum (ac innumerorum ignotorum) attigerent, atque inde, ut tramen effugitum, omnia celeriter evenirent.

source: Based on the official number on the official site of the game, the number of players already jumped by a magnitude.
target: Secundum numerum in situ officiali ludi, numerus lusorum iam per magnitudinem creverat.

source: He stared at the counter as it slowly but surely ticked up and couldn’t help but curse himself.
target: Aspiciebat numerationem, dum lente sed certissime augeretur, et se maledicere non potuit.

source: "Architect of my own demise…” he exclaimed softly while leaning back and putting his hand on his eyes. “Why couldn’t I keep my mouth shut?”
target: "Architectus ipsius exitii mei..." exclamavit leniter, dum recubans et manum super oculos posuens. "Cur os meum non retinere potui?"

source: "Stupid, stupid, Sam! The butterfly effect! The more you do, the more things change!” he lambasted himself.
target: "Stulte, stulte, Sam! Effectus papilionis! Quo plura fecisti, eo magis res mutantur!" maledixit sibi.

source: Then, with a growl, he returned his attention to the screen and began his research anew.
target: Deinde, cum rugitu, mentem suam ad scrinium redegit et iterum inquisitionem coepit.

source: If things changed, then his plans would also have to change.
target: Si res mutantur, consilia eius quoque mutanda erunt.

source: He returned to the game in a foul mood.
target: In ludum se rediit in animo misero.

source: Barely giving Lucky a quick pat on his head, he immediately headed out, leaving the staff perturbed, as he was usually very kind to them.
target: Paene Lucky caput celeriter pulsat, et statim exiit, operarios perturbatos relinquens, cum plerumque eis benignus esset.

source: Thankfully, the new people were still stuck in the beginner towns, but soon they would be let loose…
target: Gratias, novi adhuc in oppidis initiatorum haerebantur, sed mox liberabuntur…

source: He took a quick trip to the alchemist, buying some sparklescale powder, which allowed one to cover invisible enemies, causing them to become sparkling, which allowed people to hunt them.
target: Celerem iter ad alchymistam fecit, emens pulverem squamiformem micantem, qui hostes invisibiles operire, eos micantes reddere, quo homines eos venari poterant.

source: Then a few more potions, and then simply began power walking towards the gate that would allow him to begin his journey to the area where Old Marak told him the monster was.
target: Postea paucae potionum, deinde simpliciter ambulare celeriter coepit ad portam, quae ei iter ad regionem incipiendam concederet, ubi senex Marak monstrum esse dixerat.

source: A few people stepped away in fright as the young man stalked through the streets with a blood‑thirsty smile on his face.
target: Pauci, metu captati, recedebant, dum iuvenis per vias insidians, vultu sanguine sitiente et risu ferocissimo ambulabat.
